about: What IS NULL answers over the bracket path resource['x'] and the literal null, two forms the PAP accepts and that answer false under every other operator recorded (j7-bracket-path, df1, df2). IS NULL is the one operator that is true over an absent key (s6a), so a form read as an absent attribute is true here for every request. Each case is sent a resource that holds x and one that does not; dn-is-null-over-a-plain-path is the control, false and true. The agent's condition parser accepts both forms.
